issue.title: Ctrl+W N — numbered tab hints and an in-place tab jump
issue.description: In Bob's Obsidian, every main-area tab carries a quiet numeral (1–9, in reading order across splits) beside its title, and Ctrl+W followed by that digit focuses exactly that tab where it lives — selected inside its own split, never moved, cloned, or reopened — while the numerals brighten into accent key caps when the Ctrl+W card appears and the destination numeral flashes once to confirm the jump.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/obsidian_ctrl_w_numbered_tab_jump.md requests this work
